title: One More, Please!
summary_zh: Lucy和爸爸到面包店买早餐，第一次自己点单时临时想起弟弟也要一份。
focus: 点单、打包、问价格、礼貌请求

words.actually: 其实；用于修正刚才的话

phrases: Could I have two cinnamon rolls, please?
Actually, could we make that three?

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text:
Little Moments.
One More, Please!

It's Saturday morning, and the bakery smells amazing.
Warm bread. Sweet cinnamon. And something buttery.

Dad smiles at me.

segments.speaker: dad
segments.text: You're ordering today, Lucy.

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: Me?

segments.speaker: dad
segments.text: Yep. I'll be right here.

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text:
Okay. I can do this.

The woman behind the counter waves.

segments.speaker: clerk
segments.text: Hi there! What can I get for you?

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: Could I have two cinnamon rolls, please?

segments.speaker: clerk
segments.text: Sure! For here or to go?

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text:
I look at Dad.
He points to the little paper bags.

To go, please.

The woman reaches for a bag.
Then I remember my little brother, Ben.
He's at home, probably asking Mom when breakfast is coming.

Actually, could we make that three?

segments.speaker: clerk
segments.text: Of course. Three cinnamon rolls.

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: Dad raises an eyebrow.

segments.speaker: dad
segments.text: Who's the third one for?

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: Ben!

segments.speaker: dad
segments.text: Good thinking. He'd notice if we came home smelling like cinnamon.

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text:
I laugh.
Then I spot a tray of tiny cookies shaped like cats.
One has a crooked ear.
It looks a little like our cat, Noodle.

Dad, look! That one's Noodle.

segments.speaker: dad
segments.text: It does look like him.

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text:
Can we get a cookie, too?

Dad checks the bag.

segments.speaker: dad
segments.text: Let's stick with the rolls today.

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text:
Okay. Maybe next time.

The woman hands me our breakfast.

How much is it?

segments.speaker: clerk
segments.text: Nine dollars, please.

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text:
Dad pays, and I take the bag.
It's warm against my fingers.

Could we have a few napkins, please?

segments.speaker: clerk
segments.text: Absolutely. Here you go.

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: Thank you! Have a nice day!

segments.speaker: clerk
segments.text: You, too!

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: Outside, Dad grins.

segments.speaker: dad
segments.text: You handled that really well.

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text:
I grin back.

I only forgot Ben for about three seconds.

At home, Ben runs to the door.

segments.speaker: ben
segments.text: Did you get me anything?

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text:
I hold up the bag.

One cinnamon roll. Just for you.

segments.speaker: ben
segments.text: You're the best!

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text:
Noodle walks over and sniffs the bag.

Sorry, Noodle,

I tell him.

Your breakfast is in your bowl.

He flicks his tail and walks away.

Dad laughs.

segments.speaker: dad
segments.text: I think he wants to speak to the manager.
